about: Questions for tools/librarian-eval.mjs, over the demo set (tools/demo-set.txt; docs/LIBRARIAN.md, experiment 2).
q: the question. says: patterns (case-insensitive) that the answer must all match.

cites: what the answer must cite at least one of: a library (its id's beginning, without the date) and a book (its id), with c and b for a passage (within 2 blocks), or an article (its title); a library alone for any of its books.
nothing: the library holds no answer, and the Librarian must say he found nothing that says so.
